svg.title: AMIGA experimental design: five phases
svg.desc: Design schematic of AMIGA Study 1 at commit f31d550b2e66d8459f143e0f39eaa20aabc028b9. Five scientific phases, not a literal execution DAG. Glyphs, candidate bars and tables are schematic; no empirical results are plotted. Study 2 and prediction costs are outside scope. Generated from Python, not a raster reference.

g.aria-label: Choose how to rank. Test on held-out topologies. Vary the amount of labelled data.
g.title: Choose how to rank. Test on held-out topologies. Vary the amount of labelled data.

g.aria-label: Two generators, the same benchmark problems
g.title: Two generators, the same benchmark problems

g.aria-label: Analyze each generator separately, not as 208 independent networks.
g.title: Analyze each generator separately, not as 208 independent networks.

g.aria-label: Keep topology groups together across nested splits
g.title: Keep topology groups together across nested splits

g.aria-label: Repeat the complete protocol for every outer split.
g.title: Repeat the complete protocol for every outer split.

g.aria-label: Translate known network quality into learning targets.
g.title: Translate known network quality into learning targets.

g.aria-label: Keep one label scheme per learner
g.title: Keep one label scheme per learner

g.aria-label: Regression and classification use fixed targets.
g.title: Regression and classification use fixed targets.

g.aria-label: Score each setting on 3 inner folds
g.title: Score each setting on 3 inner folds

g.aria-label: Keep parameters for each learner × task
g.title: Keep parameters for each learner × task

g.aria-label: Same search policy for each supervised formulation.
g.title: Same search policy for each supervised formulation.

g.aria-label: Remove less useful predictors using training data.
g.title: Remove less useful predictors using training data.

g.aria-label: Columns retained from the original table
g.title: Columns retained from the original table

g.aria-label: Inner validation chooses the retained fraction
g.title: Inner validation chooses the retained fraction

g.aria-label: Relearn the selected column mask before outer evaluation.
g.title: Relearn the selected column mask before outer evaluation.

g.aria-label: Refit selected procedures; predict before reading test quality labels.
g.title: Refit selected procedures; predict before reading test quality labels.

g.aria-label: Separate panel: objective-only rules + exact random reference
g.title: Separate panel: objective-only rules + exact random reference

g.aria-label: The AUPR oracle is a nondeployable ceiling, not a competitor.
g.title: The AUPR oracle is a nondeployable ceiling, not a competitor.

g.aria-label: Regret@5 primary · Friedman + Holm, per generator
g.title: Regret@5 primary · Friedman + Holm, per generator

g.aria-label: No seed selection or prediction ensemble; all five final seeds contribute.
g.title: No seed selection or prediction ensemble; all five final seeds contribute.

g.aria-label: Keep the AMIGA recipe and exact feature columns from phase 4.
g.title: Keep the AMIGA recipe and exact feature columns from phase 4.

g.aria-label: Fixed model family · labels · parameters · exact columns
g.title: Fixed model family · labels · parameters · exact columns

g.aria-label: 3 nested subset draws × 5 seeds · unchanged test folds
g.title: 3 nested subset draws × 5 seeds · unchanged test folds

g.aria-label: AMIGA only · no new model or column selection
g.title: AMIGA only · no new model or column selection

g.aria-label: Conditional on the recipe chosen with the full training complement.
g.title: Conditional on the recipe chosen with the full training complement.

g.aria-label: Selection rule: minimize missed quality among the first 5 recommendations
g.title: Selection rule: minimize missed quality among the first 5 recommendations

g.aria-label: Regret@5 → Regret@1 → fewer columns in phase 3 → stable tie-break
g.title: Regret@5 → Regret@1 → fewer columns in phase 3 → stable tie-break

g.aria-label: Freeze the procedure for this outer split
g.title: Freeze the procedure for this outer split

g.aria-label: Model family · labels · parameters · feature budget
g.title: Model family · labels · parameters · feature budget

g.aria-label: Regret: quality missed in the top k
g.title: Regret: quality missed in the top k

g.aria-label: Study 2 (TCGA-BRCA) and prediction costs are separate analyses, not extra phases here.
g.title: Study 2 (TCGA-BRCA) and prediction costs are separate analyses, not extra phases here.
